analysis.reasonEn: Maintain wait-and-see stance for the third consecutive session. RSI at 46.4 remains in neutral territory, and MACD histogram shows improvement but is still converging. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at 100,240 KRW above the 20-day low of 82,710 KRW, but low volume (0.55x) reduces conviction. Weekly ADX at 36.2 indicates a trend, but daily directionality is absent.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (102,800 KRW) vs SMA5 (106,386 KRW) / SMA20 (102,315 KRW) / SMA50 (117,787 KRW) — Trading around the middle band, below short-term SMA5, above mid-term SMA20, below long-term SMA50.
· Position vs SMA100 (111,293 KRW) / SMA200 (89,709 KRW) — Downtrend in the medium to long term.
· 52-week position (55.1%) + Current price level near historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.6→46.4) — Exited oversold territory, continuing in neutral zone, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (589.7033→1738.0354) — Improving in negative territory, weak signal for bearish reversal yet.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 102,315 KRW) — Sideways trading near the middle band, band width at 25.61% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (82,710 KRW) — Based on Pivot S1 (85,340 KRW) and 20-day low (82,710 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (126,140 KRW) — Expectation of upward reversal if Pivot R1 (117,630 KRW) is broken.
· 5-day / 20-day High-Low Pattern — Higher Low forming (5-day low 100,240 KRW > 20-day low 82,710 KRW), suggesting potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.55x) — Below 5-day average, low conviction in price movement.
· Current Stage Diagnosis — Accumulation phase, maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of directionality.
